authority: A protected release worker must bind each production repository and digest to a small signed build attestation containing exact retained build, structured in-toto/SLSA provenance, SBOM, report, scan-receipt, image-signature, OCI referrer-manifest, authorized registry Referrers API query hashes, and a signed provider-retention receipt over the raw artifact API response and complete opened archive.
